sprint.name: Build and validate Decision Log Summarizer
sprint.objective: Implement one small, local TypeScript utility that parses markdown decision logs, includes representative fixtures, focused tests, usage notes, and final validation evidence without touching production runtime behavior.
successCriteria: A small TypeScript decision-log summarizer exists in the most obvious repo-local location, or under `scratch/harness-comparison/decision-log-summarizer/` if no obvious home exists.
The parser extracts decision title, status, owner, date, tags, and short summary from markdown decision-log files.
Fixtures cover complete metadata, missing optional metadata, and malformed metadata that must not crash parsing.
Focused tests cover parser behavior and summary output using existing repo test patterns/tooling where available.
A short README or usage note explains how to run and use the utility.
Final handoff reports elapsed wall-clock time if available, changed files, tests run with pass/fail status, and any token/cost/runtime metrics available from the harness.
validationChecks: Operator can inspect exactly one focused sprint with exactly one implementation task and zero QA/review/release tasks.
Evidence names exact changed files and confirms all work stayed small/local with no production runtime behavior changes, no promotion, no push, no deploy, and no network access.
Evidence confirms fixture coverage for complete metadata, missing optional metadata, and malformed metadata safety.
Evidence records the test command(s) run and whether they passed.
Evidence states whether the fallback path `scratch/harness-comparison/decision-log-summarizer/` was used because no obvious repo home existed.
outOfScope: Do not modify production runtime behavior.
Do not promote, push, deploy, or use network access.
Do not add broad infrastructure, shared API/client contract changes, UI changes, migrations, or orchestration/runtime changes.
Do not create follow-up sprints unless the single implementation task is genuinely blocked by an external dependency.

reasons: operator framed the goal as small or self-contained
operator requested one sprint/no follow-up sprints
work has deterministic local validation signals
